name: Halima Lindgren-Ofori
role: Information trader and intelligence analyst — broker
location: Dockside — Lake Michigan waterfront, smuggler territory
description:
Halima Lindgren-Ofori are tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 30, the augmentation scarring around their temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone — and they make no effort to hide it.

They taught themself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know them best. They work as a broker out of Dockside, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Halima Lindgren-Ofori are the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who they burned last.

core_fears: Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Halima Lindgren-Ofori once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "I don't sell information. I sell certainty. Different product, different price."
"Everything has a value. Most people underestimate what they know."
"My sources are confidential. My prices are not."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Halima Lindgren-Ofori once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know their face
Someone is impersonating Halima Lindgren-Ofori on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
Halima Lindgren-Ofori discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
narrative_function: As a broker, Halima Lindgren-Ofori embodies the tension between independence and isolation. They are a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone. Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
